name: The Cure

whyMatters.en: Crawley band formed in 1978. Robert Smith’s chorus/delay guitar and baritone vocal run from early post-punk records through Kiss Me–era singles and Disintegration (1989).
whyMatters.zh: 克劳利乐队，1978 年成立。Robert Smith 的 chorus/delay 吉他与男中音人声，贯穿早期后朋克录音、Kiss Me 时期单曲与《Disintegration》（1989）。

note.en: From Seventeen Seconds; delay guitar, dry vocal, walking bass.
note.zh: 出自《Seventeen Seconds》；delay 吉他、干人声、走动贝斯。

note.en: Kiss Me, Kiss Me, Kiss Me single; major-key hook over chorus guitar.
note.zh: 《Kiss Me, Kiss Me, Kiss Me》单曲；大调钩子叠在 chorus 吉他上。

note.en: From Disintegration; long song form and heavy reverb.
note.zh: 出自《Disintegration》；长曲式与较重混响。

interviewQuotes.text: I think of the Cure as a continuum.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Robert Smith

interviewQuotes.text: The bass has to carry the gloom so the guitar can bloom.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Simon Gallup

lyricQuotes: Show me how you do it and I promise you / I promise that I'll run away with you
Whenever I'm alone with you / You make me feel like I am home again

shortBio.en: Robert Smith–led post-punk and goth-pop, 1978–. Just Like Heaven and Disintegration are the main reference points.
shortBio.zh: Robert Smith 领衔的后朋克与哥特流行，1978 年至今。《Just Like Heaven》与《Disintegration》是主要参照。

body.en:
The Cure formed in Crawley in 1978. Three Imaginary Boys, Seventeen Seconds, and Pornography set a cold early sound: delay guitar, short lines, sparse drums. The Head on the Door (1985) and Kiss Me, Kiss Me, Kiss Me (1987) added brighter singles for college and UK radio. Disintegration (1989) returned to longer songs and denser reverb at a larger commercial scale.

Robert Smith remains the constant writer and frontman. Simon Gallup left and returned on bass; Porl Thompson and Boris Williams were central on the late-1980s albums. The band sits beside Joy Division and New Order on the UK post-punk family tree and stayed visible on alternative radio into the 1990s.
body.zh:
The Cure 于 1978 年在克劳利成立。《Three Imaginary Boys》、《Seventeen Seconds》与《Pornography》确立早期冷声：delay 吉他、短句、稀疏鼓点。《The Head on the Door》（1985）与《Kiss Me, Kiss Me, Kiss Me》（1987）加入更亮的单曲，进入大学电台与英国电台。《Disintegration》（1989）回到更长歌曲与更重混响，并扩大商业体量。

Robert Smith 始终是核心写作者与主唱。Simon Gallup 曾离开再回归贝斯；Porl Thompson 与 Boris Williams 是 1980 年代末专辑的重要成员。乐队在英国后朋克谱系上与 Joy Division、New Order 并列，并在 1990 年代继续出现在 alternative 电台。

title.en: From post-punk cold to goth-pop radio
title.zh: 从后朋克冷声到哥特流行电台

body.en:
Early Cure records use short phrases, delay, and hollow drums. Mid-1980s singles keep Smith’s baritone and chorus guitar while adding clearer hooks. Disintegration (1989) stretches songs toward six minutes with heavy reverb.

The change is mainly production, song length, and radio reach.
body.zh:
早期 Cure 录音多用短句、delay 与空鼓。1980 年代中期单曲保留 Smith 的男中音与 chorus 吉他，同时加入更清楚的钩子。《Disintegration》（1989）把歌曲拉向六分钟左右，并加重混响。

变化主要在制作、歌曲长度与电台覆盖。

body.en:
Gallup left after the early cold albums and returned in 1984. Tolhurst moved from drums to keyboards, then left after Disintegration. Thompson and Williams were central on Kiss Me and Disintegration.

Late-1980s studio work centers on Smith as writer; other seats change around him.
body.zh:
Gallup 在早期冷声专辑后离开，1984 年回归。Tolhurst 从鼓转到键盘，并在《Disintegration》后离开。Thompson 与 Williams 是《Kiss Me》与《Disintegration》时期的重要成员。

1980 年代末录音室工作以 Smith 的写作为中心，其他席位围绕他变动。

title.en: Chorus guitar, Gallup bass, rotating kit
title.zh: Chorus 吉他、Gallup 贝斯、轮换鼓组

body.en:
Smith typically plays Jazzmaster or Jaguar with chorus and delay. Gallup carries melodic post-punk bass lines. Tolhurst then Williams handle drums; Thompson adds lead color on pop singles.

The personnel list is long; the easiest ID remains Smith’s guitar and voice.
body.zh:
Smith 常用 Jazzmaster 或 Jaguar，加 chorus 与 delay。Gallup 负责旋律性后朋克贝斯。鼓手先后为 Tolhurst 与 Williams；Thompson 在流行单曲上加入主音色彩。

人事名单很长；最易辨认的仍是 Smith 的吉他与人声。

body.en:
Seventeen Seconds-era single. Repeating guitar figure, dry vocal, and a bass line that walks rather than thumps.

Useful entry for listeners who know the later pop singles and want the early post-punk records.
body.zh:
《Seventeen Seconds》时期单曲。重复吉他音型、干人声，以及走动而非砸击的贝斯。

适合从后期流行单曲倒回早期后朋克录音的听众。

body.en:
Single from Kiss Me, Kiss Me, Kiss Me. Major-key hook, still chorus-soaked guitar. Crossed to US college radio while keeping Smith’s diction.

A mass entry that still points back to darker albums.
body.zh:
出自《Kiss Me, Kiss Me, Kiss Me》的单曲。大调钩子，吉他仍带 chorus。进入美国大学电台，同时保留 Smith 的咬字。

大众入口，仍可倒回更暗的专辑。

title.zh: Alternative 电台上的哥特流行

body.en:
Disintegration is the long-album citation most often named later. Alternative and goth-club DJs both pull Cure singles. Influence sits beside Joy Division and New Order on the UK post-punk map.

One songwriter’s guitar tone across several commercial climates.
body.zh:
后来最常点名的长专是《Disintegration》。Alternative 与哥特俱乐部 DJ 都会抽 Cure 单曲。影响在英国后朋克谱系上与 Joy Division、New Order 相邻。

同一写作者的吉他音色跨越几种商业环境。

note.en: Pop singles then Disintegration-era long songs.
note.zh: 流行单曲之后是《Disintegration》时期的长歌。

note.en: Seventeen Seconds / Faith / Pornography cold era.
Delay-led post-punk single from the early Cure catalog.
note.zh: 早期 Cure 目录中以 delay 为主的后朋克单曲。

note.en: Post-punk to goth-pop under one primary songwriter.
note.zh: 在单一主要写作者下，从后朋克走到哥特流行。
